The '''Ragnook Mountains''' were located on the western side of the main continent of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. 

Its range stretched from the northern [[Koth Ice Cap]] to the south. To the west and the east of the Mountains were bands of plains; the eastern plains housed most of the planet's population. Beyond these, plains lay the immense [[Arblis Forest]] that covered most of the continent.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

[[Raynor Mining Enterprises]], the first owner of Kothlis, as well as [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]] workers, built the first installations on the planet at the eastern feet of the Mountains: a temporary facility and a [[Abandoned smelting plant|smelting plant]].<ref name="guide" /> 

[[Rysais Producers Co-operative]] had [[farm/Legends|farms]] on the lower feet of the mountains that had been terraced for that purpose. Hidden springs high atop the mountains were the source of the popular [[Ragnook Spring Water]]. A secluded northern valley within the Mountains, with [[crystal/Legends|crystal]]-rich walls  housed a secret [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|v-150]] [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]], for the planet's defense; the crystals hid the cannon from [[sensor/Legends|sensors]].<ref name="guide" />
